controls.name: Anti-phishing policy exists and enabled
controls.evidence: Found 3 enabled anti-phishing policies with recommended settings.

controls.name: Safe Links policy is enabled
controls.evidence: No Safe Links policy was found. Users are not protected against malicious URLs.
controls.recommendation: Create and enable a Safe Links policy in the Microsoft 365 Defender portal.

controls.name: Safe Attachments policy is enabled
controls.evidence: No Safe Attachments policy detected. Malware protection is not applied to emails.
controls.recommendation: Enable Safe Attachments with a strict detection level for all recipients.

controls.name: Anti-malware policy exists
controls.evidence: Anti-malware policy exists but filtering is set to 'Off' for some file types.
controls.recommendation: Enable malware filtering for all common file types and set action to 'Quarantine'.

controls.name: Mailbox auditing is enabled
controls.evidence: Mailbox audit logging is enabled for 95% of mailboxes.

controls.name: SMTP AUTH is disabled
controls.evidence: SMTP AUTH is still enabled for legacy clients. This bypasses modern authentication.
controls.recommendation: Block SMTP AUTH and require modern authentication for all clients.

controls.name: POP/IMAP is disabled
controls.evidence: POP3 and IMAP4 are disabled for all users.

controls.name: Anti-spam policy is enforced
controls.evidence: Anti-spam policy exists but bulk email threshold is set too high.
controls.recommendation: Lower the bulk email spam threshold and enable safety tips.

controls.name: Guest user access reviewed
controls.evidence: Guest user access settings require manual verification due to external sharing policies.
controls.recommendation: Review guest user access settings and external sharing policies quarterly.

controls.name: Transport rules for data loss prevention
controls.evidence: No transport rules configured for sensitive data types.
controls.recommendation: Create transport rules to block or quarantine emails containing sensitive data.

controls.name: DKIM signing enabled
controls.evidence: DKIM is enabled and signing is active for all accepted domains.

controls.name: DMARC policy configured
controls.evidence: DMARC policy is set to 'none' instead of 'quarantine' or 'reject'.
controls.recommendation: Update DMARC policy to 'quarantine' or 'reject' after monitoring p=None reports.

controls.name: SPF record published
controls.evidence: SPF record is published and includes all authorized sending services.

controls.name: Exchange admin roles limited
controls.evidence: Too many users have Exchange Administrator role assigned.
controls.recommendation: Apply least-privilege principle and assign Exchange Administrator role only to required accounts.

controls.name: MFA enforced for all users
controls.evidence: MFA is not enforced for all users. 12 users have MFA disabled.
controls.recommendation: Enforce MFA for all users and disable legacy authentication protocols.

controls.name: Conditional Access policies configured
controls.evidence: Conditional Access policies exist but do not cover all risk conditions.
controls.recommendation: Expand Conditional Access policies to block legacy auth and require compliant devices.

controls.name: Legacy authentication blocked
controls.evidence: Legacy authentication protocols (POP, IMAP, SMTP AUTH) are still enabled.
controls.recommendation: Block all legacy authentication protocols using Conditional Access.

controls.name: Password protection policy enabled
controls.evidence: Password protection policy is enabled with banned password lists.

controls.name: Guest user MFA enforced
controls.evidence: No guest users are present in the tenant.

controls.name: Message encryption enabled
controls.evidence: Office 365 Message Encryption is enabled for external recipients.

recommendations.title: Enable Safe Attachments protection
recommendations.description: Safe Attachments provides an additional layer of protection against unknown malware.
recommendations.remediation: Create a Safe Attachments policy in the Microsoft 365 Defender portal with a strict detection level.

recommendations.title: Enforce multi-factor authentication
recommendations.description: MFA significantly reduces the risk of credential-based attacks.
recommendations.remediation: Enable MFA for all users and block legacy authentication protocols.

recommendations.title: Enable Safe Links protection
recommendations.description: Safe Links checks URLs in real-time to protect against phishing and malware.
recommendations.remediation: Create a Safe Links policy in the Microsoft 365 Defender portal.

recommendations.title: Limit Exchange Administrator role assignments
recommendations.description: Excessive Exchange admin privileges increase the blast radius of a compromise.
recommendations.remediation: Review and remove unnecessary Exchange Administrator role assignments.

recommendations.title: Configure data loss prevention transport rules
recommendations.description: Transport rules help prevent sensitive data from leaving the organization.
recommendations.remediation: Create transport rules to block or quarantine emails containing sensitive data types.
